recipes.title: Concert harp arpeggio
recipes.intent: Plays the CC0 FreePats harp bank (selection via the openDAW factory catalogue); loads its samples on first play.
recipes.code: $: note("c3 e3 g3 c4 e4 g4 c5 g4").s("fp_harp").gain(0.8).room(0.3)
